title: Product discovery
description: Learn from customer evidence and test the assumptions behind product choices.

sources.title: Christensen Institute, Jobs to Be Done Theory

rules.instruction: For a Jobs to Be Done interview, ask about a recent decision, what prompted it, what else the person considered and what made change difficult.
rules.verification: Trace each proposed job to specific interview evidence. Look for a conflicting example before applying the finding to another customer segment.

rules.instruction: Agree on a recurring rhythm for customer contact. Link each discovery activity to an outcome or open product decision.
rules.verification: Review recent customer sessions and identify which finding confirmed, changed or left open the decision it addressed.

rules.instruction: When using an opportunity solution tree, connect each candidate solution to a customer opportunity and an outcome. Choose the assumption most likely to change the decision and plan a small test.
rules.verification: Walk from the outcome to the planned test and verify that the test result could change which solution the team pursues.
